title: Fix SdfSamplingRowBatchJob per-work-item scratch isolation
description:
## Summary
`SdfSamplingRowBatchJob` (`Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Morphology/Extraction/DensityGrid.cs`) is scheduled as `job.Schedule(workItemCount, 1)` (one parallel work item per `RowsPerExecute`-row batch), but every work item computes `rowValueOffset = localRow * rowScratchStride` where `localRow = row - firstLocalRow` resets to `0..RowsPerExecute-1` in every work item, and `ScratchValues` is sized `rowScratchLength * rowsPerExecute` (capacity for one batch only). Two concurrently-running work items therefore write the same `ScratchValues` offsets while `SdfProgramEvaluator.EvaluateInto` uses that region as per-operation evaluation workspace. `[NativeDisableParallelForRestriction]` suppresses the Unity job-safety check that would otherwise flag the aliased writes. This can silently produce wrong density values non-deterministically.

## User Mandate
> "Synthesize the latest unreviewed audits and re-review the other recent audits from the last 2 days or so in order to extract all relevant information into the task system, or to improve the agent/skills/process/development pipeline aspects"

STRICT. Do not narrow or re-scope this requirement; surface any proposed change first.

## Scope
- Make scratch ownership genuinely disjoint per work item (include a `workItemIndex`-dependent term in the offset and size `ScratchValues` for the concurrent work-item set, or derive `rowValueOffset` from the global row index while re-checking `ScratchValueBudget`).
- Preserve the row-batching performance change and the bounded-memory intent of `ScratchValueBudget`.
- Keep the dead, correct `SdfSamplingJob` (`SdfProgram.cs`, `index * Operations.Length`) as a reference until the fix lands, then remove it (see dead-code cleanup).

## Acceptance Criteria
- No two concurrently-scheduled work items can write the same `ScratchValues` index; proven by explicit offset/size derivation, not by pattern-matching.
- `DensityGrid.SamplePortable` output matches the reference evaluator for a complex transformed/symmetric/smooth-union fixture.
- Repeated generations of the same definition produce identical density-grid and extracted-mesh fingerprints in Unity (ties to `TSK-0204`).
- Peak scratch memory stays within the documented `ScratchValueBudget` intent, or the budget change is justified with measurement.

## Validation
Whole-project compile gate; focused Unity EditMode/runtime SDF sampling parity tests; a repeated/stress determinism run (many generations) to catch scheduling-dependent drift; `TSK-0204` fingerprints.

## Findings
Source-confirmed 2026-09-11 by three independent audits: `docs/audits/audit-sdf-sampler-race-2026-09-11.md`, `docs/audits/creaturecreator-round26-scratch-race-still-present-2026-09-11.md`, and `docs/audits/audit-race-followup-and-streamlining-2026-09-11.md` (which also confirms the other two `[NativeDisableParallelForRestriction]` jobs are correctly disjoint). The 14-seat performance council (`docs/audits/creaturecreator-performance-council-review-26-09-11-0001.md`) recorded this race as FIXED by commit `0c20d167b206d3a8cf5d6314dcc933374b770e90`; the current offset arithmetic does not support that claim.

## Blockers
None for the source fix. Unity execution was unavailable in the audit environment; closure requires the Unity gates above.

## Next Step
Land the offset/size correction with a focused ordering/offset regression, then run the repeated determinism check.

comments.body: Post-pull verification (2026-09-11). Origin now contains `656243f` "Fix parallel SDF sampler scratch partitioning", which adds `workItemScratchOffset = checked(workItemIndex * RowsPerExecute * rowScratchStride)` plus checked offsets. This does **not** complete the fix. In `DensityGrid.SamplePortable` the scratch buffer is still allocated as `scratchLength = rowScratchLength * rowsPerExecute` (`DensityGrid.cs:89`) — one work-item batch — while the new offset spans `workItemCount` batches (required capacity = `rowScratchStride * RowsPerExecute * workItemCount` ≈ `rowCount * rowScratchStride`). For any `workItemIndex >= 1`, `valueOffset` therefore exceeds the buffer length and `SdfProgramEvaluator.EvaluateInto` writes out of bounds into `ScratchValues`: the same-slice race is traded for out-of-bounds access. The new `SdfSamplingRowBatchJobTests` also under-allocates — it sizes scratch `rowScratchStride * workItemCount`, but the job stride per work item is `RowsPerExecute * rowScratchStride`, so it needs another `* RowsPerExecute`. Required fix: size production scratch for the full concurrent work-item set (or re-derive a bounded scheme) and correct the test allocation, then re-check the `ScratchValueBudget` intent. Keep this task Critical and open; the incoming audit's claim that the allocation "already reserves enough storage" is refuted by `DensityGrid.cs:89`.

## Fix landed and Unity-validated (2026-09-11); AC2 blocked by a separate culling-parity defect

### Implemented
`DensityGrid.SamplePortable` no longer schedules the whole grid through one undersized buffer. It now:
- derives `rowScratchStride = cornersX * operationCount` and `scratchPerWorkItem = rowsPerExecute * rowScratchStride`;
- sizes scratch to the scheduled work-item set: `workItemsPerWindow = max(1, ScratchValueBudget / scratchPerWorkItem)`, `scratchLength = scratchPerWorkItem * workItemsPerWindow` (peak scratch stays within `ScratchValueBudget`);
- processes rows in windows of `workItemsPerWindow * rowsPerExecute`; each window is a self-contained schedule whose work items fit the buffer.

`SdfSamplingRowBatchJob` gained `RowStart` so the global row → (y,z)/sample mapping stays correct across windows. Within a window, `workItemScratchOffset = workItemIndex * RowsPerExecute * rowScratchStride`, so concurrently-scheduled work items have disjoint scratch by construction, and every offset is `checked`.

`SdfSamplingRowBatchJobTests` now sizes scratch `rowScratchStride * rowsPerExecute * workItemCount` and adds a sentinel guard region after the scratch slice; the guard fails if any write escapes the slice.

### Acceptance criteria
1. **Met by derivation.** Schedule width is bounded by `workItemsPerWindow`; offsets are `workItemIndex`-scaled, so no two concurrently-scheduled work items share a `ScratchValues` index.
2. **Not met — blocked by a separate defect.** `GenerationIntegrityTests.SamplePortable_ComplexSdf_MatchesReferenceEvaluatorAtEverySample` fails at sample (0,0,0): reference 0.26608497, production `Infinity`. Production applies the root potential-envelope pre-cull (`RootHasPotentialBounds`); the reference call uses `allowCulling: false`. This is the culling-parity question the SDF-race handoff flagged, not the scratch defect. The handoff's guidance applies: a diagnostic A/B with pre-culling disabled is an investigation only; do not weaken culling without a proof and parity test. Candidate owners: `TSK-0119` (harden fast SDF culling and non-finite field consumers) or `TSK-0201`.
3. **Met.** `GenerationIntegrityTests.SampleAndExtract_RepeatedRuns_AreBitIdentical` (5 runs) passes; EditMode `CreatureGenerationConfigTests` determinism passes; editor regeneration gave 20962 tris / 10483 verts on 4/4 runs.
4. **Met by construction.** Window sizing keeps scratch ≤ `ScratchValueBudget`.

### Evidence
- **Negative control:** restoring the old size (`rowScratchStride * workItemCount` = 48) makes the guard run throw `IndexOutOfRangeException: Index 48 is out of range of '48' Length` at `SdfProgramEvaluator.EvaluateInto` (`SdfProgram.cs:198`) from `MultipleWorkItems_IsolateScratchRowsAndMatchReference`. Control reverted afterwards.
- Full suites: EditMode 148/148; PlayMode 751 total / 709 passed / 42 failed (`TestResults.xml`; complete list recovered by recursive parse past the 25-cap runner).
- 12 baseline failures recorded in `TSK-0194` now pass (the determinism cluster).

Files: `Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Morphology/Extraction/DensityGrid.cs`, `Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/SdfSamplingRowBatchJobTests.cs`. Not committed. Task stays open only because AC2 is owned by the culling-parity defect.
